approximation_limits: Main frame windows remain through-holes at source bounds; rounded horizontal windows become rectangles.
Four source inclined wheel suspension arms retain their real open diagonal profiles and 22 mm bracket depth; small pivot reliefs and intermediate channel steps are omitted.
Four source shock axes reach their actual upper pivots; coil wire is replaced by a coarse spring barrel and tapered upper housing, preserving visible solid contact with chassis and arms.

Internal payload platform slots, small mounting plates and fine corner details are omitted to fund exterior suspension; the largest middle-platform aperture, two lower-platform apertures and both side-frame windows remain through-holes.
Thin plate thickness and primary source planes are retained; small bores, folded ears and bevels are omitted.
Paired chassis support webs remain open; their bottom channel strips and top flange details are omitted.
Grey/black covers use source fork-shaped skins, sloping nose and source case side section; secondary skin steps and small exterior brackets are omitted.
The dark inclined camera panel retains its source 20 degree direction and measured 12 mm thickness.
Small upper-frame mounting feet are omitted; continuous uprights reach the lower source platform directly.
Tyres have eight circumference segments and four profile rings; visibly coarse in close views.
The lidar uses eight circumference segments; source origin, height and main profile rings remain unchanged.
Bidirectional vertex samples are diagnostic approximations, not full-surface Hausdorff bounds.
